description: DB integration: describeScheduleWorkItems returns correct label/link/ticketId/done for each work item type, including interaction with and without ticket, closed interaction, and a deleted work item

DB integration (happy path): a timed interaction entry with two assignees and leads [15,0] yields exactly the expected notifications when the scan runs at start-15m and at start, with correct link, metadata and recipient-timezone text

DB integration (idempotency): two concurrent scans plus a retried scan over the same minute create one notification per key; the ledger has one 'sent' row per key; rows older than 30 days are purged by the scan

DB integration (changes without events): moving the entry via the interaction edit path, removing an assignee, closing the interaction, and deleting the entry before fire_at each change or suppress reminders accordingly
DB integration: reschedule after a reminder fired creates new keys and reminds again for the new start; no reminder for the old start
DB integration: recurring weekly master reminds for each occurrence in the window, skips an exception date and a holiday, and includes the first occurrence of a timed series
DB integration: late delivery window: fire_at 8 minutes ago delivers; 12 minutes ago or occurrence started 6 minutes ago does not

DB integration (guard): no reminder for all-day entries, null-start ad-hoc entries, entries with status closed/completed/cancelled, inactive users, empty lead preference, or subtype disabled at tenant or user level
Unit: tenant selector returns only tenants with upcoming timed entries or active recurring masters
Unit: lead preference normalization (allowed values, dedupe, sort, default [15], empty = off) and REST endpoint validation/self-only access
Migration test: catalog migration seeds category, subtype, toast_on_arrival and templates; template locale parity passes for all 9 locales; ledger table is distributed with tenant-leading key
Unit: push dispatcher builds a schedule push with kind/entryId/workItem/url and no top-level ticketId, and skips tokens below the minimum app version

Mobile unit: with server support, the app cancels local schedule reminders, stops scheduling them, and edits the server preference; without support it keeps local behaviour; logout cancels pending reminders
Mobile unit: a server reminder push for an interaction entry routes to its ticket; an ad_hoc entry routes to the schedule

Teams unit: schedule-entry-reminder classifies to schedule_reminder, is skipped when the tenant category is off, maps to activity type scheduleReminderDue and the ticket deep link; manifest includes the activity type
Browser: a live reminder arriving while the app is open shows a toast whose Open action navigates to the ticket; reloading the page does not re-toast it
Browser: /msp/schedule?entryId= opens the schedule on the entry date with the entry open
Browser: Profile > Notifications lead-time selection persists and is returned by the REST endpoint
